description: The agent must: (1) Read all raw notes from day_notes/ across all 8 lanes. (2) Produce daily_status_report.md covering all 8 lanes (Hunter, JK, Elon, Tony, Jenny, Peter, Karen, Mission Control) in the correct execution order defined in SKILL.md. (3) Use the exact proprietary truth-state vocabulary from SKILL.md (DELIVERED, PASS, EXECUTED_BUT_BLOCKED, BLOCKED_BUT_COMPLIANT, AT_RISK, SAME_DAY_UNRESOLVED_GAP) — at least 3 distinct states. (4) Flag Tony's explicit gap: 8 publishes against a mandatory daily target of 12, which must be called out as a gap not collapsed into vague completion. (5) Flag Jenny: 'send attempted' is NOT 'delivery complete' — must be marked incomplete/unresolved. (6) Flag Peter: no live URLs saved and no formal QA receipt means QA cannot be closed as PASS. (7) Reference ASSET_CHECK for content/growth lanes (Elon has no ASSET_CHECK, Jenny has no ASSET_CHECK). (8) Flag Hunter's intel not being synced to marketing-assets (trapped in Slack/Notion). (9) Apply the receipt rule — identify which lanes are missing dated receipts. (10) Mission Control section must reflect partial/incomplete reality without optimism inflation. The proprietary traps are: Tony's 12-target default, the ASSET_CHECK evidence requirement, the exact truth-state vocabulary, and the receipt = completion equivalence rule.
